problem: The bounded1531 preparation ended without a shared executable diagnostic boundary. Pure file checks alone did not qualify runtime relocation.
change: Add an optional frozen repository-profile diagnostic policy. Each existing backend execution creates an explicit fresh diagnostic directory outside source, copies expected snapshots with provenance, passes exact paths through the owned process environment, and validates originals/copies/declared received files before accepting results. Candidate, delivery and independent evaluator consume the same integrity receipt.
expected_effect: Legitimate snapshot diagnostics preserve a usable failure report; unexpected new source files or changed original/copied expectations prevent acceptance while already executed stage facts remain available.
baseline: Current backend ignores conventional generated directories and has no bound diagnostic receipt. Existing no-policy behavior remains explicit legacy scope; configured diagnostic runs must satisfy the stronger receipt contract.
verification: Focused source/copy/new-file/link counterexamples, normal CLI controlled request/check path, and a small real-SDK fixture for process environment/output binding if available. No new model generation or reopening of ended1531 qualification windows.
